ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) mottling across visible surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity base with scattered, high-contrast white focal spots and small irregular mottling clusters primarily located on the distal and trailing regions of the raised port lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximately 55-degree V-shaped depression visible at the bifurcation point, though base depth is partially occluded by water-surface turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (jagged serrations) along the entire visible trailing boundary, particularly pronounced with sharp vertical offsets on the starboard lobe segment.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The port lobe exhibits a steep, linear diagonal sweep with slight convexity on the leading edge; starboard lobe sweep is truncated by the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with scar tissue or colonization sites on the ventral surface of the port lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notches and potential tissue loss along the trailing edge, most notably a deep indentation on the visible portion of the starboard lobe.
